children: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia--KK Mart Retail has signed a retail underwriting agreement with Maybank Investment Bank for its proposed listing on Bursa Malaysia's main market.
The convenience mart operator plans to offer up to 840 million shares, comprising 630 million existing shares and 210 million new shares.

Of the total, 735 million shares, representing up to 21% of the company's enlarged share capital, will be allocated to institutional and selected investors. The remaining 105 million new shares, or 3.0% of the enlarged share capital, will be offered to the Malaysian public, eligible directors, employees and other contributors to the company.
Dow Jones Newswires had earlier reported on the company's listing plans.
KK Mart operated 996 stores across Malaysia as of Feb. 28, 2026.
Managing Director Chai Kee Kan said the listing would accelerate the company's expansion and strengthen its nationwide store network.
